Vacuum and Trash shulker boxes, now for **Minecraft 1.17 to 26.3** on **Spigot, Paper and Purpur**.

**New in 2.1**
- One jar runs on every version from 1.17 to 26.3 (Java 16 or newer, whatever your server already uses).
- Works on Spigot as well as Paper and Purpur.
- Custom textures (via the included resource pack) on 1.21.4 and newer; older versions show the normal shulker box look.

**Features**
- **Shulker Box of Vacuum** (any shulker box + hopper): off-hand stores blocks you mine, main hand stores items you pick up. A full box hands extras to your inventory.
- **Shulker Box of Trash** (any shulker box + lava bucket): off-hand deletes blocks you mine, main hand deletes items you pick up.
- Any colour of shulker box works, and crafting keeps the box's colour and contents.
- Shulker boxes are never stored or deleted, and breaking chests or other containers is left alone.
- Boxes from earlier versions keep working.

Marked beta: it's built and compile-checked against the 1.17 and 26.3 APIs, but hasn't been play-tested on every version in between. Test on a copy of your world first, and report problems on GitHub.
